rules.breadth: signal-day completed RTH breadth >=50% above EMA50
rules.pending: buy-stop remains eligible for up to 3 sessions; cap-blocked order may fill later while still valid
rules.simultaneous: when more triggers than free slots occur in same 15m timestamp, higher signal 60d return is admitted first
rules.same_bar: existing stops before new admissions; newly filled trade can stop on same bar; no slot refill again within that same timestamp

limitations: Current 53-symbol universe is projected backward, so survivorship/post-selection bias remains.
Each 4-year shard is seeded with 140 calendar days of portfolio-state pre-roll (except the first global shard) and 420 days of indicator warmup.
Same-15m simultaneous admissions are prioritized by signal-day 60d return; intrabar ordering inside a 15m candle is otherwise unavailable.
Risk is expressed in fixed 1R-per-position units; dynamic equity compounding is not modeled.
